player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Bo fwete sala kitambi ya [macro micro] ti ntalu 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Konso kima fwete vanda na kati ya 0 mpi 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, mukongo to col kele na nganda ya range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: The player must play in the next micro board.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

next_board.specific: mikro-panneau {nxt} ya bo ke salaka na kati

game_action.played: Mwana {player_id} akelaki na micro board {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (lilaya {row}, kolona {col}). Mwana {opponent_id} aweza kukelaka na {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} mebaka Tic Tac Toe ya Nsuka! (na Kingelesi).
